p.intro:
NYC's throwback calendar is a handful of themed nights, each one named for an era or for nostalgia itself. They cluster in two places. In Manhattan it is the East Village, where DROM on Avenue A and the basement club Deluxx Fluxx on East 11th Street both run repeat nights. In Brooklyn it is Bushwick and Williamsburg, with parties at The Sultan Room, Purgatory and The Meadows.

The eras are easy to tell apart. PROMISCUOUS does 2000s club bangers, Take Me Out does 2000s indie and disco punk, and Bangerangerz plays the biggest 2010s club and pop tracks all night. Nightbreed goes back further, with synth, post punk, goth and 80s. Deluxx Fluxx keeps it loose with NOSTALGIA, a throwback classics night, plus a 2010s rap and R&B costume edition for Halloween weekend. reggaetonLABS adds a reggaeton throwbacks party on Thanksgiving Eve. Pick by decade and you will know what you are walking into.

picks.why: Take Me Out is the pick if your 2000s were indie rather than Top 40. Nick Marc of Tiswas plays indie-dance and disco punk at DROM on Avenue A in the East Village on Friday, November 20. The listing names Arctic Monkeys, The Strokes, LCD Soundsystem and Bloc Party as the kind of records you will hear, not as performers.

PROMISCUOUS brings a full night of 2000s club hits to The Sultan Room in Bushwick on Friday, November 13. The team behind the touring throwback night Sorry For Party Rocking runs it, and the reference points are Timbaland, Nelly Furtado and JT. It is a tribute night, so none of those artists will appear.

Nightbreed takes over the downstairs room at Purgatory in Bushwick on Thursday, October 29, with synth, post punk, goth and what the listing calls 80s sleaze for queer bats. Jamie K of SVMMON plays with special guest Jeffo!. It is an early-evening party and it is listed as free, which makes it an easy start to Halloween weekend.

Bangerangerz is a straight 2010s night at DROM in the East Village on Saturday, November 14. Alex Jay plays the decade's biggest club and pop tracks all night, from a list that runs through Avicii, Calvin Harris, Robyn, Charli XCX, Daft Punk and Disclosure. Those are songs on the playlist, not guests on the bill.

Nostalgia: Mask On is the Halloween weekend edition of the Deluxx Fluxx throwback night, billed in its title as a 2010s rap and R&B costume party, on Friday, October 30. The venue presents it in its basement club at 125 East 11th Street in the East Village. No DJs are named, so come for the decade and the costumes.

reggaetonLABS brings Reggaeton Throwbacks to the main room at The Meadows in Williamsburg on Wednesday, November 25, which is also Thanksgiving Eve. The theme is the golden era of perreo, so the listing points to classic reggaeton. No DJs are named yet, which makes this one a pick for the theme alone.

sections.body: For the '80s, Nightbreed at Purgatory goes dark with synth, goth and post punk. For the 2000s, choose PROMISCUOUS at The Sultan Room for club bangers or Take Me Out at DROM for indie and disco punk. The 2010s belong to Bangerangerz at DROM and to Nostalgia: Mask On, the rap and R&B costume night at Deluxx Fluxx. If you just want old favorites without picking a decade, Deluxx Fluxx runs NOSTALGIA: A Throwback Classic Night on Friday, November 13 and Friday, November 27, with no era named. Reggaeton fans have Reggaeton Throwbacks at The Meadows.

Every party on this page is 21+ unless its own page says otherwise, so bring a physical ID. Themed nights can sell out, and Halloween weekend and Thanksgiving Eve are the dates to buy ahead for. Doors, end times and current prices are on each party's page, right next to this text.

faq.q: Where can I find a 2000s throwback party in NYC?
faq.a: PROMISCUOUS plays 2000s club bangers at The Sultan Room in Bushwick on Friday, November 13. Take Me Out covers 2000s indie-dance and disco punk at DROM in the East Village on Friday, November 20.

faq.q: Is there a 2010s party in NYC?
faq.a: Yes. Bangerangerz at DROM in the East Village plays 2010s club and pop tracks all night on Saturday, November 14, with Alex Jay on the decks. Nostalgia: Mask On at Deluxx Fluxx on Friday, October 30 is billed as a 2010s rap and R&B costume party.

faq.q: Is there an emo night in NYC right now?
faq.a: Not at the moment. No emo night is listed on this page yet, and new ones will appear here when they are announced. For guitar-driven nostalgia in the meantime, Take Me Out at DROM plays 2000s indie and disco punk on Friday, November 20.

faq.q: Are any throwback parties in NYC free?
faq.a: Right now, one: Nightbreed, downstairs at Purgatory in Bushwick on Thursday, October 29, with synth, post punk, goth and 80s. The other throwback nights are ticketed, with live prices on each party's page.

p.intro:
There are 23 free parties on the NYC calendar right now, and 21 are still open; the two Halloween parties, at Sleepwalk and Seventh Heaven, are sold out. Brooklyn has 12 and Manhattan 11. By neighborhood, the Lower East Side has 10, Williamsburg 9, Bushwick 3 and Nolita 1. Two venues carry most of the list: The Delancey hosts 10 reggaetonLABS nights, and Sleepwalk on Bushwick Avenue hosts 9, mostly its Wednesday vinyl happy hour.

The weekly pattern is simple. Fridays at The Delancey are Reggaeton Fridays, and Saturdays are Safaera, which adds Latin music to the reggaeton. Wednesdays at Sleepwalk are Date Nite, where Hotel Kismet puts crate diggers on vinyl with happy hour specials at the bar. Thursdays are the wild card: a goth night at Purgatory, a Nervous Records speakeasy at Shinsen and a melodic-to-hard techno night in the main room at SILO Brooklyn.

picks.why: Date Nite is the easiest free night on this page: a Wednesday happy hour at Sleepwalk on Bushwick Avenue, presented by Hotel Kismet, with DJs playing vintage and global grooves on vinyl. On November 4 the posted rotation points to DJ Gutzilla, though that date is not separately confirmed. It repeats every Wednesday through December 16.

Nervous Records sets up a speakeasy-style pop-up at Shinsen on the Bowery on Thursday, November 5, with Cosmo and Mike Nervous on the decks. Entry is by RSVP on DICE, and the listing tells you to arrive early. It is the only free Manhattan night on this page outside The Delancey.

Techno Thursday moves into the main room at SILO Brooklyn in Bushwick on November 19 for Melodic2Hard, presented with Aziman Tribe. The first half is hypnotic melodic techno, and the second half switches to fast hard techno until close. Roman Messer and Bruce Wayne lead a bill that also lists Asa, Phantom, Vida Libre, Tay and Gio.

Nightbreed fills the downstairs room at Purgatory in Bushwick on Thursday, October 29, with synth, post punk, goth and 80s for queer bats, in the listing's own words. Jamie K of SVMMON plays with special guest Jeffo!. It starts and ends early, which leaves the rest of Halloween weekend open.

Safaera is the reggaetonLABS Saturday party at The Delancey on the Lower East Side, with reggaeton and Latin music. The November 28 edition, the Saturday of Thanksgiving weekend, spells out the terms: no cover charge, a two-drink minimum for entry later in the night, and a DICE ticket that guarantees early entry. No DJs are named.

Reggaeton Fridays is the other half of the reggaetonLABS weekend at The Delancey, every Friday from November 6 through December 4. On November 6, a DICE ticket guarantees entry early in the night, so grab one instead of walking up late. The title tells you the music: reggaeton, with no DJs named.

sections.body: Free on this page means no ticket price, not a guaranteed walk-in. Most of these run on a free DICE RSVP: Nervous Records says entry is by RSVP and to arrive early, and the Techno Thursday title says free with RSVP. At The Delancey, a DICE ticket guarantees entry early in the night, and the Thanksgiving weekend listings add a two-drink minimum for later entry. Free nights also fill up. Both Halloween parties here, ParaPara at Seventh Heaven and BLOODLUST at Sleepwalk, are already sold out.

Every free party on this page is 21+, so bring a government ID, even to a Wednesday happy hour. Grab the RSVP as soon as you know you are going. Doors, end times and any entry cutoff are on each party's page, right next to this text.

faq.q: Where can I go out for free in NYC on a weekend?
faq.a: The Delancey on the Lower East Side has free reggaetonLABS parties every Friday and Saturday from November 6 through December 5: Reggaeton Fridays on Fridays and Safaera on Saturdays, which adds Latin music.

faq.q: Are there free happy hours with DJs in Brooklyn?
faq.a: Yes. Date Nite: Vinyl Happy Hour runs every Wednesday at Sleepwalk on Bushwick Avenue from October 28 through December 16, with vinyl DJs and happy hour specials. The posted rotation is DJ Gutzilla on the first and third Wednesdays, DJ Alyx Astryx on the second and a special guest on the fourth.

faq.q: Do I need an RSVP for free parties in NYC?
faq.a: For most of these, yes. Nervous Records Speakeasy at Shinsen is RSVP on DICE, Techno Thursday at SILO Brooklyn is free with RSVP, and at The Delancey a DICE ticket guarantees early entry. Two free Halloween parties on this page are already sold out.

faq.q: Is there a free techno party in NYC?
faq.a: Techno Thursday: Melodic2Hard at SILO Brooklyn in Bushwick on Thursday, November 19 is free with RSVP. It moves from melodic techno to hard techno, with Roman Messer and Bruce Wayne leading the bill.

p.intro:
NYC has 23 New Year's Eve parties listed for Thursday, December 31, 2026: 15 in Manhattan and 8 in Brooklyn. Brooklyn's are concentrated in Williamsburg, with 4, and Bushwick, with 3, plus &ME at the Brooklyn Navy Yard in Fort Greene. Manhattan spreads out more, with Koreatown at 3 and the Lower East Side and Chelsea at 2 each.

Most of the list falls into two camps. Joonbug presents 17 bar and lounge packages, usually a DJ on Top 40, hip-hop and house, often with a midnight countdown, and several with an open bar. The other six are club nights: &ME at the Duggal Greenhouse, Loud Luxury at Marquee, San Pacho at Elsewhere, Tinzo + Jojo and DJ Minx at 99 Scott, Gravagerz at SILO Brooklyn and a reggaeton warehouse party at The Meadows. Pick the camp first, then the room. Nothing on this page is sold out yet.

picks.why: &ME plays the Duggal Greenhouse at the Brooklyn Navy Yard, presented by Stranger Than. The promoter calls it his first solo New York show apart from Keinemusik, and it runs from New Year's Eve into the early morning of January 1. No support acts are confirmed yet, so this one is about the headliner and the room.

Elsewhere takes a New Year's Eve party to 99 Scott in Bushwick, with Tinzo + Jojo, listed by DICE as Book Club Radio, and DJ Minx. It is separate from the party at Elsewhere's own building, which has San Pacho in the Hall and two more rooms still to be announced. Elsewhere notes that openers and set times can change.

reggaetonLABS throws a nine-hour reggaeton party at The Meadows on Meadow Street in Brooklyn, running into New Year's Day. Riobamba, Danny NYC and DJ Loko are named. The ticket includes an hour of open bar at the start, a midnight champagne toast and an interactive countdown, in a warehouse the promoter says has a strong sound system.

If you want to see the ball drop without standing in the street, this is the most direct option: a Joonbug party on the 31st-floor rooftop of Margaritaville Resort Times Square, with views of the Ball Drop and the Manhattan skyline. A live DJ plays Top 40, hip-hop, house and mashups. No DJ is named.

The White Horse Tavern on Hudson Street dates back to the 1800s and is known for its literary history. On New Year's Eve, Joonbug runs it as an open bar night with a live DJ on Top 40, hip-hop and dance favorites, plus a midnight countdown. It is the West Village pick for people who want a pub, not a club.

Downtown Crawl Til the Ball Drops is a bar crawl rather than one room. Registration is at The Skinny Bar on Orchard Street on the Lower East Side, and the named stops so far are Bobby's Night Out on Loisaida Avenue and Coyote Ugly on East 14th Street, with more venues to be announced. Good for a group that gets restless.

sections.body: Choose your ticket early and read what it covers. At Superior Ingredients in Williamsburg, The Roof and The Room are separate tickets, and only All Access gets you into both. Hotel Alameda in Chelsea splits the night between Creatures Rooftop for the countdown and Music for a While downstairs for later. Nothing here is sold out yet, so now is when you have the full menu. The subway runs all night in NYC, which makes a late Brooklyn finish easier to get home from.

All 23 parties are 21+, so bring a valid ID. Tickets can sell out at any point before the night. Doors, end times and what each ticket includes are on each party's page, and lineups can move: Elsewhere notes that openers, set times and room assignments can change without notice.

faq.q: Where can I watch the ball drop at a party in NYC?
faq.a: Rooftop Ball Drop View, on the 31st-floor rooftop of Margaritaville Resort Times Square, has views of the Ball Drop. Ainsworth Midtown on East 33rd Street has screens for it, and Sony Hall, off Times Square on West 46th Street, holds a midnight countdown.

faq.q: What are the big club New Year's Eve parties in Brooklyn?
faq.a: &ME at the Duggal Greenhouse in the Brooklyn Navy Yard, Elsewhere's two parties (San Pacho at Elsewhere, Tinzo + Jojo and DJ Minx at 99 Scott), Gravagerz at SILO Brooklyn with live aerialists and a midnight balloon drop, and the reggaetonLABS party at The Meadows.

faq.q: Are there open bar New Year's Eve parties in NYC?
faq.a: Several. Sony Hall, Blind Barber and VIRGO list a five-hour premium open bar. White Horse Tavern and 5th & Mad list an open bar, and Ainsworth Midtown is described as an open-bar package. The Meadows reggaeton party includes one hour of open bar.

faq.q: Is there a rooftop New Year's Eve party in NYC?
faq.a: Yes. Darling Rooftop on the 47th floor of the Park Lane Hotel on Central Park South, the Margaritaville rooftop in Times Square, El Nico Rooftop on top of The Penny Williamsburg, The Roof at Superior Ingredients and Creatures Rooftop at Hotel Alameda in Chelsea.

p.intro:
Five parties are on for Thanksgiving week in NYC: four on Thanksgiving Eve, Wednesday, November 25, and one on Thanksgiving night, Thursday, November 26. Four are in Brooklyn, two in Bushwick (Elsewhere and The Chocolate Factory) and two in Williamsburg, both at Superior Ingredients. The fifth is in Manhattan, a house party at PUBLIC ArtSpace, the basement venue of the PUBLIC Hotel on Chrystie Street.

This is a house and disco night first. Louie Vega brings his annual Flashback to Superior Ingredients, and Natasha Diggs leads Soul In The Horn with DJ Scratch and Terry Hunter. Elsewhere's DayBreak has no lineup posted yet. If you are back from dinner on Thursday and still want to dance, Ground Control's annual Thanksgiving party with KOFLA and Cristian Arango uses the same Williamsburg main room one night later.

picks.why: Louie Vega's annual Flashback takes the Main Room at Superior Ingredients in Williamsburg on Wednesday, November 25, presented by Nervous Records and Dance.Here.Now. Vega plays an extended set of house classics, disco, boogie and MAW records, and the promoter is bringing in a boosted sound system. They pitch it as the opening night of the holiday season.

Soul In The Horn returns to The Chocolate Factory in Bushwick on Thanksgiving Eve. Natasha Diggs leads, with DJ Scratch, Terry Hunter, Sunny Cheeba and Moonbabe named in the description and special guests to be announced. The promoter lists house, soul, disco, funk, hip hop and global rhythms, the widest musical spread of the night.

TMML Presents throws a house party in PUBLIC ArtSpace, the basement venue of the PUBLIC Hotel at 215 Chrystie Street, on Wednesday, November 25. It is the only Thanksgiving Eve party on this page in Manhattan. The listing promises house music, but no DJs are named yet, so go for the room rather than a headliner.

Ground Control brings back its annual Thanksgiving night party at Superior Ingredients in Williamsburg on Thursday, November 26, after dinner. KOFLA and Cristian Arango are the two names in the Main Room, with no support acts or genres listed. It is the only party here on Thanksgiving itself, for anyone who wants a second night out.

DayBreak is Elsewhere's own Wednesday night party in Bushwick on November 25, filed as a DJ event on DICE. The listing does not name a lineup or say which of Elsewhere's rooms it uses. Pick it if you trust the venue's booking and want a second Bushwick option on Thanksgiving Eve besides Soul In The Horn.

sections.body: Thanksgiving Eve, the Wednesday before Thanksgiving, is one of the busiest bar nights of the year in the US. Thursday belongs to family, plenty of people have the next day off, and friends are back in town for the holiday. In 2026, Thanksgiving falls on Thursday, November 26, so the big night out is Wednesday, November 25. That is why four of the five parties on this page sit on the Wednesday.

All five parties are 21+, so bring ID. Thanksgiving Eve tickets can sell out, even though none on this page has yet. Lineups are still filling in: DayBreak and the TMML party name no DJs, and Soul In The Horn has special guests to be announced. Check each party's page for doors and current prices before you head out.

faq.a: Wednesday, November 25, 2026, the night before Thanksgiving on Thursday, November 26. Four of the five parties on this page fall on that Wednesday.

faq.q: Where is Louie Vega playing on Thanksgiving Eve?
faq.a: In the Main Room at Superior Ingredients in Williamsburg, for his annual Flashback on Wednesday, November 25. He plays an extended set of house classics, disco and boogie.

faq.q: Are there parties in NYC on Thanksgiving night?
faq.a: Yes, one on this page: Ground Control's annual Thanksgiving party with KOFLA and Cristian Arango at Superior Ingredients in Williamsburg on Thursday, November 26.

faq.q: Is there a Thanksgiving Eve party in Manhattan?
faq.a: TMML Presents at PUBLIC ArtSpace, the basement of the PUBLIC Hotel on Chrystie Street, is the Manhattan option: a house party on Wednesday, November 25. The other three Thanksgiving Eve parties on this page are in Brooklyn.
